messages:
mira: Heads up  I keep getting bug reports where customers can't find cohesive guidance for 429s, timeouts, and context-limit fallbacks. Our content is scattered. Can we consolidate into one compact troubleshooting reference?
dylan: Agreed. One page with a tiny decision matrix + compact SDK snippets would be ideal. Keep examples to 6 lines max and link to sample repo for full patterns.
sam: I can draft the matrix: symptom -> immediate action -> recommended SDK helper. Example row: 429 -> backoff + reduce batch -> client.fallback.retryWithBackoff().
mira: Also add a small "header inspection" snippet showing Retry-After and x-rate-limit headers for hosted vs dedicated. Dedicated emits different header keys; add a deployment note.
dylan: For context_limit show trimming example: before/after prompt token counts and a snippet: trim_history(history, max_tokens). Emphasize when trimming is not safe (transactional state).
sam: Drafted python snippet for Retry-After parsing: ```python
r = resp.headers.get('Retry-After')
delay = int(r) if r and r.isdigit() else min(60, base_backoff)
await sleep(delay)
```
dylan: I added a node jitter example and a 3-line exponential backoff helper.
docs-bot: PR opened #3602 "single-error-troubleshooting-ref + tiny sdk snippets" (labels: docs, needs-review)
mira: Great. Please normalize fallback names in the matrix to: trim_context, retry_with_backoff, switch_model_variant, route_to_fallback. Makes it easier to search.
sam: Normalized and linked to the examples repo: github.com/redwood-inference/examples/error-handling. Ready for review tomorrow 9am PT.
dylan: I'll review then. Thanks! :thumbsup:
